$comment: Retrieval cases. Embedding calls only — no chat completions — so this runs
in the fast tier and costs fractions of a cent.
Two things are measured here, and they pull in opposite directions:
recall@k   for in-corpus questions, does the right document come back?
refusal    for off-corpus questions, does the grounding floor correctly
return nothing rather than the least-unrelated passage?
Raising the floor improves the second and hurts the first. The report prints
both, plus the score separation between them, which is what a floor should
be chosen from rather than picked round.
